name: Folder-TS-TW
title: Interactive File Folder
description: A plain grey folder sits closed until clicked, when its front flaps fold down and three tilted photo cards rise and spread out. Moving over the photos shifts them slightly.
use: A small set of photos or files should be tucked away and revealed on a playful click.
avoid: It holds at most three items and needs a click before anything becomes visible.
a11y: The folder is a clickable div with no role, tab stop or key handler, so it cannot be opened from the keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A simple grey folder with a small tab sits alone on a black stage. Opened, three white-bordered landscape photos fan up from its mouth, each tilted at a different angle.
behaves: Hovering nudges the closed folder up slightly. Clicking folds the front flaps down and lifts three photo cards into a fan, and clicking again drops them back and shuts the folder.
customise: Folder colour, scale and a list of up to three items are props; the paper sizes, fan angles and open animation are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A small folder of divs animated with CSS transitions; nothing runs until it is clicked.
demo: Three alpine landscape photos inside the folder, captioned 'Trip to the Alps, 3 photos'.
issues: The folder cannot be reached or opened with a keyboard and has no accessible name.
polishWhy: Neat and tactile with a satisfying fan-out; the grey body is plain and the caption sits outside.
